cellacdc/measurements_viewer/annotation_.doc: Widget-free time point, custom annotation, predictor and phase bookkeeping of the measurements viewer: the AnnotationDataUtils mixin (a base of MeasurementsViewerUtils in measurements_viewer/viewer_utils.py), the visited-cells column name and the 0/1 flag column checks of custom annotations. Imports no module that imports it (it is a base-class module of viewer_utils.py). Spec: measurements_viewer/__init__.py.

cellacdc/measurements_viewer/dialogs/con.doc: Conditional formatting dialogs of the measurements viewer columns and their color helpers (relative colors such as "lighter 150").

cellacdc/measurements_viewer/dialogs/pha.doc: Time point to phase translator dialog and its rule dialog (library: measurements_viewer/phase_translator.py).

cellacdc/measurements_viewer/dialogs/pre.doc: Editors of measurements viewer predictors: time point identifiers (TimepointIdentifierDialog), time point and custom annotation predictor equations, the main/other-cell filter equations, the custom annotation predictor group box, and disabled_while_nested for nested editors. The custom annotation dialog in gui/mixins/dialogs.py imports the group box lazily, only when the viewer passes predictor options. Equation syntax: timepoint_predictors.py and docs/source/equation-editor.rst.

Setup dialog of premade measurements viewer configurations: maps channel placeholders and typed inputs, with Calculate/Load of background values (background_values.py, utils/computeBackgroundValues.py).

cellacdc/measurements_viewer/dialogs/pro.doc: Recipe dialog, parameter widget and function selector of measurement processing in the measurements viewer (plugins: measurement_processing/).

cellacdc/measurements_viewer/main_window.doc: The "Columns to plot" list of the measurements viewer (ViewerColumnsGuiElements): filtering, colors, y axes and conditional formatting. Defines the default plotted columns. Spec: measurements_viewer/__init__.py.

Measurements viewer configurations (ViewerConfigurationGuiElements): saving, selecting and loading them, premade templates and mapping their input onto experiments. Defines the configuration folder path, the premade templates folder path (measurements_viewer/premade_configurations/) and the premade tag. Spec: measurements_viewer/__init__.py.

Custom annotations of the measurements viewer (ViewerCustomAnnotationsGuiElements), overriding the hooks of gui/mixins/custom_annotations.py. Library: measurements_viewer/custom_annotation_predictors.py. Spec: measurements_viewer/__init__.py.
Loading, saving, reloading and exporting data in the measurements viewer (ViewerDataIOGuiElements), the loading guards and the unsaved-changes prompts. Spec: measurements_viewer/__init__.py.

The image panel of the measurements viewer (ViewerImagePanelGuiElements): image updates, text annotations, LUTs, viewer tools, status bar label, CCA table, objects dock and image mouse events. Spec: measurements_viewer/__init__.py.

Frame, z-slice and Cell ID navigation of the measurements viewer (ViewerNavigationGuiElements). Defines ARROW_KEYS, also read by keyPressEvent in measurements_viewer/main_window/window.py. Spec: measurements_viewer/__init__.py.

Time point to phase translator UI and phase evaluation scheduling of the measurements viewer (ViewerPhasesGuiElements). Library: measurements_viewer/phase_translator.py. Spec: measurements_viewer/__init__.py.

The measurements plot of the viewer (ViewerPlottingGuiElements): time courses, measurement vs measurement, extra y axes, autoscale, phase band and point hovering/clicking. Defines the tool tip of the columns list in Time course mode. Spec: measurements_viewer/__init__.py.
Process measurements and Combine measurements in the measurements viewer (ViewerProcessingGuiElements). Spec: measurements_viewer/__init__.py.

Time point identifiers of the measurements viewer (ViewerTimepointsGuiElements) and the predictor evaluation shared with custom annotations (ViewerPredictorEvaluationGuiElements). Library: timepoint_predictors.py. Spec: measurements_viewer/__init__.py.

Builds the measurements viewer window (ViewerSetupGuiElements): actions, menus, toolbars, image/plot/navigation/annotation widgets, the measurements panel, layout, status bar, signal connections, hard-coded shortcuts and Help actions. Holds the setup-only constants (quick start text, phase translator and mask tool tips, Alt+P shortcut, label font). Spec: measurements_viewer/__init__.py.

cellacdc/measurements_viewer/position_da.doc: Widget-free per-position and per-frame data of the measurements viewer: the PositionDataUtils mixin (a base of MeasurementsViewerUtils in measurements_viewer/viewer_utils.py), the frame masking helpers (analysis_last_frame, mask_frames), the acdc_output file stamp and the intensity rescaling texts. Imports no module that imports it (it is a base-class module of viewer_utils.py). Spec: measurements_viewer/__init__.py.

cellacdc/measurements_viewer/widgets.py.doc: Private widgets and pyqtgraph items of the measurements viewer: the time course plot item and the view boxes of its extra y axes, time point lines, the columns list delegate, the shortcut-aware action and auto-shortcut text, stand-ins for main-GUI objects, and the measurements tree model of the columns panel and the processing recipe dialog.

cellacdc/measurements_viewer/workers.py.doc: Private QObject workers of the measurements viewer: the thread task worker used by runInThread (measurements_viewer/main_window/data_io.py) and the one-shot measurement processing worker.

cellacdc/measurements_viewer/main_window.doc: Builds the measurements viewer window: the attributes that the shared GUI mixins expect, actions, menus, toolbars, the image, plot, navigation and annotation widgets, the measurements panel, layout, status bar and signal connections, plus the hard-coded shortcuts and the Help actions. Spec: measurements_viewer/__init__.py.

The viewer configuration (JSON): building, saving and selecting it, premade templates (channel mapping, background summary, copy into the settings folder), mapping its input onto an experiment and the configuration loading flow. The widget-free validation lives in measurements_viewer/viewer_utils.py.

Opening folders and files, loading in a worker thread (runInThread), refusing re-entrant loads, setData/loadPosition, the unanalyzed-frames mask, reloading, saving and exporting the acdc_output tables and the unsaved-changes prompts.

Frames, z-slices, planes and Cell ID navigation: arrow keys, Next/Prev, scroll bars and spin boxes, frame range, zoom to and follow the cell, ID search, plus the hooks that the shared GUI mixins call (setFrame, updateScrollbars, update_z_slice, updateZproj, switchViewedPlane).

The image panel: updateImages, text annotation options and LUTs, viewer tools after loading, the status bar label, the CCA table window, the "Cell-ACDC objects" dock, image mouse events and no-op stand-ins for main-GUI hooks called by the shared mixins. The overrides that call super() (invertBw, addScaleBar, addTimestamp, annotateAllObjectTracks, ...) stay in measurements_viewer/main_window/window.py.

The measurements plot: time courses and measurement vs measurement plots, extra y axes, autoscale, unsupported plot options, the phase band, unanalyzed-frame shading, the current frame line and hovering/clicking points.
The "Columns to plot" list: filling and filtering it, checked columns, colors and icons, the column context menu (y axes, color, conditional formatting) and renamed columns.
Process measurements (recipe dialog, worker, recorded steps) and Combine measurements, with their warnings.
The time point to phase translator UI, applying phases on the displayed cell or all cells, and scheduling automatic, override and pending phase evaluations and clears.

Time point identifiers: adding, editing and removing them, their toolbar actions and context menu, time point marks and lines on the plot, re-evaluation, and the reserved and auto (Shift+K) shortcuts shared with custom annotations.
Evaluation of time point and custom annotation predictors shared by both features: deferred predictions, the overwrite prompt for manual edits and evaluating the predictor columns.

The viewer custom annotations: overrides of the hooks of the shared CustomAnnotationsGuiElements (columns, shortcuts, tool tips, dialog kwargs), toggling cells, predictors, re-evaluation and bulk setting. The overrides that call super() (addCustomAnnotation, loadCustomAnnotations, reinitCustomAnnot, addCustomAnnnotScatterPlot) stay in measurements_viewer/main_window/window.py.

cellacdc/measurements_viewer/position_da.doc: Widget-free access to the per-position and per-frame data of the measurements viewer, for the window and the shared GUI mixins: frame_i, posData, get_data, getAcdcDf/getFrameAcdcDf, initPosAnnotData, analysis frames, labels and IDs, lineage-tree stand-ins, unsaved/changed-on-disk table state and settings. Must not call UI methods. Base of MeasurementsViewerUtils (measurements_viewer/viewer_utils.py).

cellacdc/measurements_viewer/annotation_.doc: Widget-free bookkeeping of time points, custom annotations, predictors and phases of the measurements viewer: time point columns and session state, predictor definitions and dependencies, custom annotation columns and conflicts (overrides of the shared GUI hooks), visited cells and auto-prediction tracking, phase evaluation, colors and runs. Must not call UI methods. Base of MeasurementsViewerUtils (measurements_viewer/viewer_utils.py).

notes: Commits: C11 by default (class splits, measurements_viewer.py and measurements_viewer_utils.py items); C9 for the split of apps_measurements_viewer.py (moved whole to measurements_viewer/dialogs/predictor_editors.py in C3). modules: commit = first commit in which the module exists (widgets.py and dialogs/processing_recipe.py C5 through the widgets shard items, workers.py C7 through the workers shard item).

Item keys use the base-commit paths; the tool chains them through the C3 module_moves (measurements_viewer.py -> measurements_viewer/main_window/window.py, measurements_viewer_utils.py -> measurements_viewer/viewer_utils.py, apps_measurements_viewer.py -> measurements_viewer/dialogs/predictor_editors.py).

Stays in main_window/window.py (unlisted): the host class MeasurementsViewerWin with its class-body statements (docstring, sigClosed, NAV_* columns, bottomLayoutHeightSettingKey, showDeleteObjectShortcut, UNSUPPORTED_PLOT_TRANSFORMS/_DOWNSAMPLING), the 6 Qt-named methods (__init__, eventFilter, showEvent, mousePressEvent, keyPressEvent, closeEvent), the 18 other zero-arg super() users, pg.setConfigOption(imageAxisOrder) and run().

Stays in viewer_utils.py (unlisted): every other module-level function/constant of measurements_viewer_utils.py, the module docstring, and MeasurementsViewerUtils with 47 own methods (all its staticmethods called as MeasurementsViewerUtils.X, the zero-arg super() user load_fluo_data, and every method that names the class). INDEX_COLUMNS joins it from measurements_viewer.py.

Stays in dialogs/predictor_editors.py (unlisted, completeness A8 explicit exception): disabled_while_nested, _CustomAnnotationPredictorGroupbox, TimepointPredictorEquationDialog, CustomAnnotationPredictorEquationDialog, _TimepointCellFilterEquationDialog and TimepointIdentifierDialog (lazily imported by customAnnotationDialog in gui/mixins/dialogs.py only when predictorOptions is given).

Deviation from the viewer design: RESCALE_INTENS_HOW_TEXTS, acdc_df_file_stamp, analysis_last_frame and mask_frames move to position_data.py; VISITED_COLUMN, is_flag_column, flag_column_conflicts and flag_column_conflicts_text move to annotation_data.py. viewer_utils.py imports both modules at import time (class bases), and PositionDataUtils/AnnotationDataUtils methods read these names, so leaving them in viewer_utils.py would make an eager import cycle (importing position_data.py first would fail with AttributeError: PositionDataUtils). position_data.py imports annotation_data.py (VISITED_COLUMN); annotation_data.py imports neither.

Mixin class names follow R10 (Viewer<Topic>GuiElements): ViewerSetupMixin -> ViewerSetupGuiElements, ViewerPlotMixin -> ViewerPlottingGuiElements, ViewerMeasurementProcessingMixin -> ViewerProcessingGuiElements, the others <Name>Mixin -> <Name>GuiElements; modules from window/*.py to main_window/*.py.

Bases (R8): QMainWindow, the 12 Viewer*GuiElements, MeasurementsViewerUtils (inheriting PositionDataUtils, AnnotationDataUtils), then the gui mixins in their base-commit order at their C4 homes (gui/mixins/navigation, annotations, custom_annotations, viewer_tools, object_info, window_core, overlay). Must match the gui shard placement of the gui_viewer_tools classes (Workers/Shortcuts/DefaultSettings -> window_core.py; CcaTable/CountObjects/SearchID/HoverInfo/RegionProps -> object_info.py).
PREMADE_CONFIGURATIONS_PATH is built from __file__ at the base; C1/C3 must make it independent of the module depth (e.g. from cellacdc_path) because it moves to main_window/configuration.py.

Docstrings: the spec docstring of measurements_viewer.py moves to measurements_viewer/__init__.py in C11 and goes first there; the package text of the moves shard follows it as the "where the code lives" part (one docstring). main_window/window.py then gets the doc of the moves shard (doc_commit C11). The old docstring of apps_measurements_viewer.py (in dialogs/predictor_editors.py since C3) is deleted in C9: the dialogs/__init__.py docstring of the moves shard is its updated text (viewer design), and predictor_editors.py gets the doc given here (doc_commit C9). viewer_utils.py keeps its old docstring; C14 must update it (names of the old modules, and "inherited right after QMainWindow" -> after the Viewer*GuiElements mixins, with its bases PositionDataUtils/AnnotationDataUtils in position_data.py and annotation_data.py).
The old `if __name__ == '__main__':` block of measurements_viewer.py stays in main_window/window.py (unlisted, harmless): measurements_viewer/__main__.py is created by the moves shard in C3.

Other shards put viewer-only names into modules of this shard: widgets.MeasurementTreeModel -> measurements_viewer/widgets.py and widgets.SignalProcessingSelector -> measurements_viewer/dialogs/processing_recipe.py (widgets shard, C5), workers.MeasurementProcessingWorkerGUI -> measurements_viewer/workers.py (workers shard, C7). Those modules are first created by those commits; the docs/aliases here are the canonical ones.

Test patch targets after C11 (owner module, rule 8): MEASUREMENTS_CONFIGURATIONS_PATH/PREMADE_CONFIGURATIONS_PATH -> main_window/configuration.py; load_position and get_channels_and_segm_endnames -> viewer_utils.py (viewer_utils has no internal caller of get_channels_and_segm_endnames, so the patch scope is unchanged); QColorDialog (qtpy name bound per module) -> main_window/columns.py, its only reader; PhaseTranslatorDialog -> dialogs/phase_translator_dialogs.py, MeasurementProcessingRecipeDialog -> dialogs/processing_recipe.py, TimepointIdentifierDialog and CustomAnnotationPredictorEquationDialog -> dialogs/predictor_editors.py.

position_data.py must bind settings_csv_path by name (package global, allowed from-import), as the base module did, so that the conftest settings isolation finds it; configuration.py likewise binds MEASUREMENTS_CONFIGURATIONS_PATH at module level.

Checked: 334 MeasurementsViewerWin methods = 24 kept (6 Qt names + 18 zero-arg super() users) + 310 moved; 123 MeasurementsViewerUtils methods = 47 kept + 33 PositionDataUtils + 43 AnnotationDataUtils (frame_i property getter/setter together). No moved method is in dir(QMainWindow) on PyQt5 5.15 or PyQt6, uses zero-arg super()/__class__/name mangling/global, or names either class. Rebuilding both classes from the real base objects per this mapping resolves every attribute (1206 names on PyQt6, 1207 on PyQt5) to the same object as at the base, sigClosed included; all 45 viewer overrides of gui-mixin names resolve before the gui mixins. Import graph of the viewer modules has no cycle (window.py -> mixin modules/viewer_utils/widgets; viewer_utils -> position_data -> annotation_data; conditional_formatting -> predictor_editors at import time).
